Topic.label: Relationships Among Arcs, Chords, and Central Angles

Question: Which statement is correct?

Choices.A: Equal central angles subtend equal arcs.
Choices.B: In the same circle, equal arcs subtend unequal chords.
Choices.C: In the same circle, equal arcs subtend equal central angles.

Solution: This theorem holds only in the same circle or in congruent circles, so the statement “Equal central angles subtend equal arcs” is incorrect. In the same circle, equal arcs subtend equal chords and equal central angles.
